description: Na₃P₃HO₉ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to one H and six O atoms. The Na-H bond length is 2.56 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.94 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to one H and five O atoms to form distorted NaHO₅ octahedra that share corners with five PO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent NaHO₅ octahedra. The Na-H bond length is 2.55 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.61 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaHO₅ octahedra and corners with two PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 59-64°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.49-1.64 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaHO₅ octahedra and corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 51°. There are two shorter (1.50 Å) and two longer (1.64 Å) P-O bond lengths. H is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three Na atoms. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two equivalent Na and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two P atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent P atoms.
